After this week's Apple event, newly appointed Apple CEO John Ternus and Senior Vice President of Marketing Greg Joswiak sat down for an interview to further discuss the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo.

In an interview with Tom's Guide and TechRadar, Ternus and Joswiak discussed why Apple believes now is the right time to enter the foldable screen market. Ternus also shared his feelings during his first week as Apple CEO.

When discussing why Apple feels now is the right time to announce the iPhone Duo, Ternus explained:

"For us, what matters most is always when we feel we have a product idea that can meet our standards in quality, durability, and design. I think the most amazing thing about Duo is that it perfectly demonstrates the integration of hardware and software, creating a product that is truly different from anything else. This is virgin territory for us, because we have the opportunity to rethink many different elements. This is clearly evident in the hardware, software, and design. Everything fell into place, and it simply felt like the right product."

Joz then added, pointing out that Apple believes other smartphone manufacturers' performance in the foldable device space has been "utterly uninspiring."

When discussing competitors' foldable phone screens, Ternus further stated: "If you've looked at the products on the market, not only do they feel plastic and cheap, but the screens also have issues with bumps and creases."
